text: Aerospace engineering is an engineering discipline that studies the design, manufacture, testing and application of aircraft (aircraft and spacecraft), integrating knowledge from multiple fields such as mechanics, materials science, automatic control and information technology. Among them, aviation refers to aircraft within the atmosphere (such as planes and helicopters), while aerospace refers to spacecraft outside the atmosphere (such as satellites, rockets, and space stations). This discipline is based on the theories of Newtonian mechanics, aerodynamics and celestial mechanics. It solves the core problems of aircraft in design, propulsion, navigation and orbit control through systems engineering methods, and is an important pillar of national defense science and technology and high-end manufacturing.
